verdict.rationale: A live probe shows https://react.dev/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a structured React documentation index. The docs are also served as agent-friendly markdown at .md URLs (e.g. /learn.md, /reference/react-dom/client/createRoot.md), so an agent can be pointed directly at either. Missing for 10: first-party documentation explaining or promoting llms.txt/markdown docs for agent use, and independent community corroboration of agent workflows using them.
